title: Widget Update Ruined the Tracking Flexibility
body: I used to love the old iOS home screen widget, where I could increment my habit progress one step at a time. For example, if I had to complete a habit twice a day, I could mark it once in the morning and once again later. Now, with the new widget, a single tap completes the entire habit, making it impossible to track partial progress throughout the day. This removes the flexibility and satisfaction of tracking habits gradually. Please bring back the old widget behavior or at least add an option to choose how the widget marks progress.
author: RogerArt99
